source.strict_access: Only official source DOI/version/file links; HTTP 401/429 or missing data => access STOP, never fabricated records.

published_frame.seed_screen: Only plants with >=20 viable germinable seeds eligible for genotyping; seed production conditional on selection.
published_frame.independence: 33 mothers nested within 12 plots on ONE farm; original article already modeled pollinator effects on genetic mating.

required_columns.E: relative maternal attractiveness visits per 15 minutes

source_gate: Original signed-response model fitting was not run under CY001; its strict 15–17 per-mother source gate stops upon one source 12 and remains archived.
Before fitting corrected CY002, verify both original ZIP entry SHA256 and workbook digest as in official Dryad metadata.
Source-only mother/plot/typed-offspring structural roster must match exactly: 33 mothers, 12 plots, 549 children with 1x12, 1x15, 5x16, 26x17.
No source mother omitted for the low typed-offspring count. There is no predeclared per-mother lower threshold beyond complete original row.
Mother-specific rpm and seed outcome values must not be used to change regression, selection gate, plot grouping, denominator or model.
Keep original A–AB column semantics; do not infer unique mother outcomes from the source metadata sheet.
Any other identity/header mismatch stops rather than being silently repaired.

primary.endpoint: original rpm of progeny from same mother; lower is greater paternity diversity; not LA005's nonmaternal-allele lower bound
primary.M0: intercept + mother allele count + log1p(conspecific donor density) + log1p(floral richness) + log1p(floral density) + strip type indicator
primary.M1: M0 + log1p(relative maternal visit attractiveness per 15 minutes)
primary.fit: training-fold standardized non-intercept ridge normal equations, penalty lambda=1, intercept unpenalized
primary.prediction: clip rpm predictions to [0,1] in both M0 and M1
primary.validation: 12 leave-one-WHOLE-plot-out folds; each mother appears in exactly one held-out fold
primary.metric: pooled mother-average squared error and MAE; report each plot n and M0/M1 losses
primary.estimand: delta=MSE(M0)-MSE(M1), positive indicates lower held-out error with visit predictor
primary.positive_gate: delta>0 AND relative reduction >=5% of M0 MSE AND positive delta in >=8 of 12 plot folds
primary.negative_gate: NO_PRACTICALLY_PORTABLE_INCREMENT when any one criterion fails
primary.no_site_pvalue: Plots from a single farm are not independent landscapes; no nominal 33-mother i.i.d. inference.

secondary.endpoint: log1p(AB seed number), only in the outcome-selected 33 mothers, not generalizable to initial 144
secondary.models: Exactly same predictors and ridge lambda; no response clipping
secondary.analysis: 12 same plot folds, descriptive MSE/MAE and sign only; never rescue primary based on secondary.

firewall: Study published the functional guild–mating association already; this analysis tests held-out portability, not first discovery.
Cannot claim outcrossing rate or genetic compatible pollen from rpm alone.
No selection of additional guild covariates or favorable response after outcome opening.
No deleting plots, retuning lambda, revising transformations or screening by seed outcome.
Raw third-party worksheets or maternal records never committed.
No direct numeric pooling with LA005 or interpretation as island–urban convergence.
Preserve LA001/LA002 failed seed prediction and LA005 tiny within-study marker prediction.
original_protocol_result: CY001_SOURCE_GATE_STOP: published 15-17 typed offspring expectation is contradicted by one original 12-typed maternal record

blinding_and_analysis_disclosure.note: During initial original file exploration, a spreadsheet schema preview inadvertently included header plus the first FOUR mother rows across A:AC, displaying their rpm and seed counts before CY002 freeze. No site-heldout errors, associations, or model fits were computed at that point.
blinding_and_analysis_disclosure.revised_design_after_source_only_counts: Only the offspring typing structural admissibility condition changed; the original response, predictors, lambda=1, 12 plot folds and >=5%/8 plot positive decision rule were copied without revision.
blinding_and_analysis_disclosure.interpretation: Classify CY002 as protocol-preserving corrected exploratory replication, not a fully preregistered independent confirmatory test.
